data.narrative:
Applied Atomics is a seed-stage nuclear energy company founded by Ben Kellie and Paul Keutelian that has raised $8M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 11 peers: three public companies (Oklo, Nano Nuclear Energy, and Sprout) and eight private firms including X-Energy, Fuse Energy, and Exodys Energy operating in the nuclear energy sector.

The stage-progression method is the applicable valuation approach given the seed stage and limited peer data. Using total capital raised as a proxy for intrinsic value, the $8M raised is adjusted by a 2.5x multiplier typical for the seed-to-next-stage transition, yielding an implied valuation of $20M. The peer-median method was not applicable due to insufficient comparable data points at the same stage and similar valuation tier within the nuclear energy subsector; while four same-sector peers exist, none met the threshold of three or more comps in narrow filters.

The triangulated valuation range supported by this analysis is $17M (low) to $23M (high), with a median of $20M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty around stage-progression multipliers specific to frontier nuclear technologies. Key sensitivities include the timing and terms of the next funding round and relative progress on core technical and regulatory milestones versus peer cohorts.
